events.strDescriptionEN:
Marco Bezzecchi won the 2026 Qatar motorcycle Grand Prix at the Lusail International Circuit. Having started from pole position, Bezzecchi dominated the race to take the victory ahead of Marc Márquez and Raúl Fernández.
This crucial win adds 25 championship points to Bezzecchi's season tally as the MotoGP paddock prepares for the final rounds of the 2026 calendar.
